note: The Midway's Meshy props (3D Carnival Midway spec, section 9). Each prompt is the global prefix plus the asset prompt. Models are generated at build time only, never at runtime; the optimized files live in site/assets/midway/<game>/<prop>.glb.
prefix: Dark Victorian steampunk carnival prop, weathered hardwood, tarnished antique brass, subtle wear and patina, realistic PBR materials, game-ready single object, centered on origin, no background, neutral studio lighting.

assets.prompt: Hanging vintage carnival pendant lamp with tarnished brass dome shade, protective wire cage, warm Edison bulb inside, short iron chain.
Weathered dark mahogany carnival game booth counter with chipped burgundy trim, tarnished brass corner brackets, scratched tabletop.
Ornate antique silver-and-brass carnival token coin with embossed circus star emblem and milled edge, subtle tarnish.

A single dome-shaped shell-game cup: an upside-down polished dark walnut half-shell like a small bowl turned over, solid and closed on top, with a thin tarnished brass filigree band around the bottom rim and a small brass knob on top. One piece, no lid, no hinge.
assets.note: Reworded from the spec's prompt, which produced an open clamshell box instead of a cup that covers the pea.

assets.prompt: Vintage thick-glass carnival milk bottle with long narrow neck and embossed ring ridges.
A single flat circular toss ring, like a quoit or donut-shaped hoop, made of thick braided hemp rope wrapped in three places with tarnished brass wire. Only the ring, nothing else.
assets.note: Reworded from the spec's prompt: the first result was the wrong object.

assets.prompt: Heavy wooden carnival strongman mallet with iron-banded head and taped hickory handle.
Domed antique tarnished brass striker bell with iron mounting bracket.

Antique brass-and-walnut carnival cork pop rifle with octagonal barrel.
Heavy weighted cast-aluminum carnival milk bottle with chipped cream paint and dents.
Scuffed vintage stitched leather baseball with weathered red seams.
Antique carnival throwing dart with knurled brass barrel, steel needle tip, and crimson feather flights.
Framed weathered corkboard target wall with tarnished brass corner plates.

A classic vintage skee-ball alley machine, long and narrow, about four times longer than wide. A long gently inclined polished oak bowling lane with low side rails runs from the front, ends in a small curved ramp hump, then a tall tilted target backboard at the far end with five concentric round ring cups stacked up the board and two small corner cups at the top. A tall wire safety net frame above the backboard. Victorian carnival style, dark walnut cabinet, brass trim. Viewed from the front, empty, no balls.
assets.note: Regenerated: the spec prompt produced only a squat ramp tray, not an alley. This one is the whole machine (lane plus cabinet with a round target face); the page adds the scoring rings on that face.
